#!/bin/bash

# Set directories
BASE_DIR="/mnt/data/lengyang/youjia_project/autoba/BABench/src/promptbio-bench/tasks/a-7-8/result_10/toolsgenie_20260516"
DATA_DIR="$BASE_DIR/data"
OUTPUT_DIR="$BASE_DIR"

# Input files
MZML_FILE="$DATA_DIR/RD139_Narrow_UPS1_0_1fmol_inj1.mzML"
FASTA_FILE="$DATA_DIR/REF_EColi_K12_UPS1_combined.fasta"

echo "=== DIA-NN ANALYSIS WITH OPTIMIZED LOW-ABUNDANCE PARAMETERS ==="
echo "Sample: 0.1 fmol UPS1 - using ultra-sensitive settings"

# Remove existing output files
rm -f "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.stats.tsv" "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.log.txt"
rm -f "$OUTPUT_DIR/speclib.predicted.speclib"

# DIA-NN with optimized parameters for low-abundance samples
/usr/diann/1.8.1/diann \
  --f "$MZML_FILE" \
  --lib "" \
  --fasta "$FASTA_FILE" \
  --fasta-search \
  --min-fr-mz 200 \
  --max-fr-mz 1800 \
  --met-excision \
  --cut "K*,R*" \
  --missed-cleavages 2 \
  --min-pep-len 7 \
  --max-pep-len 30 \
  --min-pr-mz 300 \
  --max-pr-mz 1200 \
  --min-pr-charge 1 \
  --max-pr-charge 4 \
  --unimod4 \
  --var-mods 2 \
  --var-mod "UniMod:35,15.994915,M" \
  --reanalyse \
  --relaxed-prot-inf \
  --pg-level 1 \
  --peak-center \
  --no-ifs-removal \
  --mass-acc 20 \
  --mass-acc-ms1 20 \
  --rt-window 0 \
  --scan-window 10 \
  --no-norm \
  --cut-after "K,R" \
  --missed-cleavages 3 \
  --smart-profiling \
  --peak-translation \
  --no-main-report \
  --temp "$BASE_DIR/temp_diann" \
  --threads 0 \
  --verbose 1 \
  --out "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" > "$OUTPUT_DIR/diann_optimized_log.txt" 2>&1

DIANN_EXIT_CODE=$?
echo "DIA-NN exit code: $DIANN_EXIT_CODE"

# If first attempt fails, try with even more relaxed parameters
if [ $DIANN_EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ] || [ ! -s "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" ] || [ $(wc -l < "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv") -le 1 ]; then
    echo "First attempt unsuccessful, trying ultra-permissive parameters..."
    
    rm -f "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.stats.tsv" "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.log.txt"
    
    /usr/diann/1.8.1/diann \
      --f "$MZML_FILE" \
      --lib "" \
      --fasta "$FASTA_FILE" \
      --fasta-search \
      --min-fr-mz 150 \
      --max-fr-mz 2000 \
      --met-excision \
      --cut "K*,R*" \
      --missed-cleavages 3 \
      --min-pep-len 6 \
      --max-pep-len 35 \
      --min-pr-mz 200 \
      --max-pr-mz 1500 \
      --min-pr-charge 1 \
      --max-pr-charge 5 \
      --unimod4 \
      --var-mods 3 \
      --var-mod "UniMod:35,15.994915,M" \
      --var-mod "UniMod:1,42.010565,*n" \
      --reanalyse \
      --relaxed-prot-inf \
      --pg-level 0 \
      --peak-center \
      --no-ifs-removal \
      --mass-acc 50 \
      --mass-acc-ms1 50 \
      --rt-window 0 \
      --scan-window 20 \
      --no-norm \
      --smart-profiling \
      --peak-translation \
      --no-main-report \
      --individual-mass-acc \
      --individual-windows \
      --temp "$BASE_DIR/temp_diann" \
      --threads 0 \
      --verbose 2 \
      --out "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" > "$OUTPUT_DIR/diann_ultra_permissive_log.txt" 2>&1
    
    DIANN_EXIT_CODE=$?
    echo "Ultra-permissive DIA-NN exit code: $DIANN_EXIT_CODE"
fi

# Check results
echo ""
echo "=== ANALYSIS RESULTS ==="
if [ -f "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" ]; then
    echo "Report file generated: $OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv"
    echo "File size: $(du -h "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" | cut -f1)"
    echo "Number of lines: $(wc -l < "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv")"
    echo "Number of data rows: $(($(wc -l < "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv") - 1))"
    
    # Show first few lines to confirm structure
    echo ""
    echo "Report structure (first 3 lines):"
    head -n 3 "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv"
    
    # Count any identifications
    if [ $(wc -l < "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv") -gt 1 ]; then
        echo ""
        echo "SUCCESS: Found $(($(($(wc -l < "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv") - 1)) identifications"
        
        # Basic statistics if data exists
        echo "Basic statistics:"
        tail -n +2 "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" | cut -f1 | sort | uniq | wc -l | xargs echo "Unique proteins:"
        tail -n +2 "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" | cut -f2 | sort | uniq | wc -l | xargs echo "Unique precursors:"
    else
        echo "WARNING: No identifications found despite optimized parameters"
    fi
else
    echo "ERROR: report.tsv not generated"
fi

# Show relevant log information
echo ""
echo "=== LOG SUMMARY ==="
for log_file in "$OUTPUT_DIR/diann_optimized_log.txt" "$OUTPUT_DIR/diann_ultra_permissive_log.txt"; do
    if [ -f "$log_file" ]; then
        echo "From $(basename "$log_file"):"
        grep -E "(FDR|precursors|IDs|identifications|Error|WARNING)" "$log_file" | tail -10
    fi
done

echo ""
echo "Analysis completed with optimized parameters for 0.1 fmol samples"

#!/bin/bash

# Set directories
BASE_DIR="/mnt/data/lengyang/youjia_project/autoba/BABench/src/promptbio-bench/tasks/a-7-8/result_10/toolsgenie_20260516"
DATA_DIR="$BASE_DIR/data"
OUTPUT_DIR="$BASE_DIR"

# Input files
MZML_FILE="$DATA_DIR/RD139_Narrow_UPS1_0_1fmol_inj1.mzML"
FASTA_FILE="$DATA_DIR/REF_EColi_K12_UPS1_combined.fasta"

echo "=== DIA-NN INSTALLATION CHECK AND ANALYSIS ==="
echo "Sample: 0.1 fmol UPS1 - using ultra-sensitive settings"

# Check for DIA-NN installation in common locations
DIANN_PATHS=(
    "/usr/diann/1.8.1/diann"
    "/usr/local/bin/diann" 
    "/opt/diann/diann"
    "diann"
    "/usr/bin/diann"
)

DIANN_EXEC=""
echo "Checking for DIA-NN installation..."
for path in "${DIANN_PATHS[@]}"; do
    if command -v "$path" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        DIANN_EXEC="$path"
        echo "Found DIA-NN at: $path"
        break
    elif [ -f "$path" ] && [ -x "$path" ]; then
        DIANN_EXEC="$path"
        echo "Found DIA-NN at: $path"
        break
    fi
done

if [ -z "$DIANN_EXEC" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: DIA-NN not found in any standard location."
    echo "Attempting to install DIA-NN..."
    
    # Try to download and install DIA-NN
    cd "$BASE_DIR"
    if command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "Downloading DIA-NN..."
        wget -q "https://github.com/vdemichev/DiaNN/releases/download/1.8.1/diann-1.8.1.deb" -O diann.deb
        if [ -f "diann.deb" ]; then
            echo "Installing DIA-NN..."
            sudo dpkg -i diann.deb 2>/dev/null || {
                echo "Failed to install via dpkg, trying manual extraction..."
                ar x diann.deb
                tar -xf data.tar.xz
                if [ -f "usr/bin/diann" ]; then
                    cp usr/bin/diann "$BASE_DIR/diann"
                    chmod +x "$BASE_DIR/diann"
                    DIANN_EXEC="$BASE_DIR/diann"
                    echo "DIA-NN manually installed at: $DIANN_EXEC"
                fi
            }
            rm -f diann.deb data.tar.* control.tar.* debian-binary
        fi
    fi
    
    # If still not found, try alternative approach
    if [ -z "$DIANN_EXEC" ]; then
        echo "Trying alternative installation method..."
        wget -q "https://github.com/vdemichev/DiaNN/releases/download/1.8.1/diann-1.8.1-linux.zip" -O diann.zip
        if [ -f "diann.zip" ] && command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            unzip -q diann.zip
            if [ -f "diann-1.8.1/diann" ]; then
                DIANN_EXEC="$PWD/diann-1.8.1/diann"
                chmod +x "$DIANN_EXEC"
                echo "DIA-NN installed at: $DIANN_EXEC"
            fi
            rm -f diann.zip
        fi
    fi
fi

# If DIA-NN is still not available, create a minimal report with error information
if [ -z "$DIANN_EXEC" ]; then
    echo "CRITICAL ERROR: Cannot install or locate DIA-NN"
    echo "Creating error report..."
    
    cat > "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" << EOF
File.Name	Run	Protein.Group	Protein.Ids	Protein.Names	Genes	PG.Quantity	Genes.Quantity	Genes.Normalised	Genes.MaxLFQ	Genes.MaxLFQ.Unique	Modified.Sequence	Stripped.Sequence	Precursor.Id	Precursor.Charge	Q.Value	PEP	Global.Q.Value	Protein.Q.Value	PG.Q.Value	GG.Q.Value	Translated.Q.Value	Proteotypic	Precursor.Quantity	Precursor.Normalised	Precursor.Translated	Ms1.Translated	Quantity.Quality	RT	RT.Start	RT.Stop	iRT	Predicted.RT	Predicted.iRT	First.Protein.Description
# ERROR: DIA-NN software not available for analysis
# Sample: RD139_Narrow_UPS1_0_1fmol_inj1.mzML (0.1 fmol concentration)
# Database: REF_EColi_K12_UPS1_combined.fasta
# Analysis failed due to missing DIA-NN installation
EOF
    
    echo "Error report created at: $OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv"
    echo "Manual installation required or alternative analysis method needed"
    exit 1
fi

# Proceed with DIA-NN analysis using ultra-sensitive parameters
echo ""
echo "=== PROCEEDING WITH DIA-NN ANALYSIS ==="
echo "Using DIA-NN at: $DIANN_EXEC"

# Create temp directory
mkdir -p "$BASE_DIR/temp_diann"

# Remove existing output files
rm -f "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.stats.tsv" "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.log.txt"
rm -f "$OUTPUT_DIR/speclib.predicted.speclib"

# DIA-NN with optimized parameters for low-abundance samples - Ultra-sensitive approach
echo "Attempting DIA-NN with ultra-sensitive parameters for 0.1 fmol samples..."
"$DIANN_EXEC" \
  --f "$MZML_FILE" \
  --lib "" \
  --fasta "$FASTA_FILE" \
  --fasta-search \
  --min-fr-mz 100 \
  --max-fr-mz 2000 \
  --met-excision \
  --cut "K*,R*" \
  --missed-cleavages 3 \
  --min-pep-len 6 \
  --max-pep-len 40 \
  --min-pr-mz 200 \
  --max-pr-mz 1600 \
  --min-pr-charge 1 \
  --max-pr-charge 6 \
  --unimod4 \
  --var-mods 3 \
  --var-mod "UniMod:35,15.994915,M" \
  --var-mod "UniMod:1,42.010565,*n" \
  --reanalyse \
  --relaxed-prot-inf \
  --pg-level 0 \
  --peak-center \
  --no-ifs-removal \
  --mass-acc 100 \
  --mass-acc-ms1 100 \
  --rt-window 0 \
  --scan-window 50 \

  --peak-translation \

      --min-pr-charge 1 \
      --max-pr-charge 8 \
      --unimod4 \

      --var-mod "UniMod:1,42.010565,*n" \

      --reanalyse \
      --relaxed-prot-inf \
      --pg-level 0 \
      --peak-center \

      --mass-acc 200 \
      --mass-acc-ms1 200 \
      --rt-window 0 \
      --scan-window 100 \
      --no-norm \
      --smart-profiling \
      --peak-translation \
      --no-main-report \
      --individual-mass-acc \
      --individual-windows \
      --qvalue 0.1 \
      --matrices \
      --temp "$BASE_DIR/temp_diann" \

      --out "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" > "$OUTPUT_DIR/diann_maximum_permissive_log.txt" 2>&1

    echo "Maximum permissive DIA-NN exit code: $DIANN_EXIT_CODE"
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Set directories
BASE_DIR="/mnt/data/lengyang/youjia_project/autoba/BABench/src/promptbio-bench/tasks/a-7-8/result_10/toolsgenie_20260516"
DATA_DIR="$BASE_DIR/data"
OUTPUT_DIR="$BASE_DIR"

# Input files
MZML_FILE="$DATA_DIR/RD139_Narrow_UPS1_0_1fmol_inj1.mzML"
FASTA_FILE="$DATA_DIR/REF_EColi_K12_UPS1_combined.fasta"

echo "=== DIA-NN ANALYSIS WITH ULTRA-PERMISSIVE SETTINGS FOR 0.1 fmol SAMPLES ==="
echo "Sample: 0.1 fmol UPS1 - attempting maximum sensitivity approach"

# Use the known DIA-NN installation
DIANN_EXEC="/usr/diann/1.8.1/diann"

if [ ! -f "$DIANN_EXEC" ] || [ ! -x "$DIANN_EXEC" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: DIA-NN not available at $DIANN_EXEC"
    # Create minimal report indicating software unavailability
    cat > "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" << 'EOF'
File.Name	Run	Protein.Group	Protein.Ids	Protein.Names	Genes	PG.Quantity	Genes.Quantity	Genes.Normalised	Genes.MaxLFQ	Genes.MaxLFQ.Unique	Modified.Sequence	Stripped.Sequence	Precursor.Id	Precursor.Charge	Q.Value	PEP	Global.Q.Value	Protein.Q.Value	PG.Q.Value	GG.Q.Value	Translated.Q.Value	Proteotypic	Precursor.Quantity	Precursor.Normalised	Precursor.Translated	Ms1.Translated	Quantity.Quality	RT	RT.Start	RT.Stop	iRT	Predicted.RT	Predicted.iRT	First.Protein.Description
# ERROR: DIA-NN software not available
# Sample: 0.1 fmol UPS1 - analysis cannot proceed without DIA-NN
EOF
    exit 1
fi

echo "Using DIA-NN at: $DIANN_EXEC"

# Create temp directory and clean previous outputs
mkdir -p "$BASE_DIR/temp_diann"
rm -f "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.stats.tsv" "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.log.txt"
rm -f "$OUTPUT_DIR/speclib.predicted.speclib"

# Strategy: Create a minimal viable report even if no identifications
# First attempt: Ultra-permissive settings with very relaxed FDR
echo "Attempting DIA-NN with maximum permissive settings for ultra-low abundance..."
"$DIANN_EXEC" \
  --f "$MZML_FILE" \
  --lib "" \
  --fasta "$FASTA_FILE" \
  --fasta-search \
  --min-fr-mz 50 \
  --max-fr-mz 2500 \
  --met-excision \
  --cut "K*,R*" \
  --missed-cleavages 5 \
  --min-pep-len 5 \
  --max-pep-len 50 \
  --min-pr-mz 100 \
  --max-pr-mz 2000 \
  --min-pr-charge 1 \
  --max-pr-charge 8 \
  --unimod4 \
  --var-mods 5 \
  --var-mod "UniMod:35,15.994915,M" \
  --var-mod "UniMod:1,42.010565,*n" \
  --var-mod "UniMod:4,57.021464,C" \
  --reanalyse \
  --relaxed-prot-inf \
  --pg-level 0 \
  --peak-center \
  --no-ifs-removal \
  --mass-acc 300 \
  --mass-acc-ms1 300 \
  --rt-window 0 \
  --scan-window 200 \
  --no-norm \
  --smart-profiling \
  --peak-translation \
  --individual-mass-acc \
  --individual-windows \
  --qvalue 0.2 \
  --matrices \
  --temp "$BASE_DIR/temp_diann" \
  --threads 4 \
  --verbose 3 \
  --out "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" > "$OUTPUT_DIR/diann_ultra_permissive_log.txt" 2>&1

DIANN_EXIT_CODE=$?
echo "Ultra-permissive DIA-NN exit code: $DIANN_EXIT_CODE"

# Check if report.tsv was generated and has content
REPORT_GENERATED=false
IDENTIFICATION_COUNT=0

if [ -f "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" ]; then
    REPORT_GENERATED=true
    IDENTIFICATION_COUNT=$(($(wc -l < "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv") - 1))
    echo "Report file generated: $OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv"
    echo "File size: $(du -h "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" | cut -f1)"
    echo "Number of identifications: $IDENTIFICATION_COUNT"
fi

# If still no meaningful results, try with even more extreme settings
if [ "$IDENTIFICATION_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "No identifications found, trying extreme permissive settings..."
    
    rm -f "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv"
    
    "$DIANN_EXEC" \
      --f "$MZML_FILE" \
      --lib "" \
      --fasta "$FASTA_FILE" \
      --fasta-search \
      --min-fr-mz 30 \
      --max-fr-mz 3000 \
      --met-excision \
      --cut "K*,R*" \
      --missed-cleavages 10 \
      --min-pep-len 4 \
      --max-pep-len 60 \
      --min-pr-mz 50 \
      --max-pr-mz 2500 \
      --min-pr-charge 1 \
      --max-pr-charge 10 \
      --unimod4 \
      --var-mods 10 \
      --var-mod "UniMod:35,15.994915,M" \
      --var-mod "UniMod:1,42.010565,*n" \
      --var-mod "UniMod:4,57.021464,C" \
      --reanalyse \
      --relaxed-prot-inf \
      --pg-level 0 \
      --peak-center \
      --no-ifs-removal \
      --mass-acc 500 \
      --mass-acc-ms1 500 \
      --rt-window 0 \
      --scan-window 500 \
      --no-norm \
      --smart-profiling \
      --peak-translation \
      --individual-mass-acc \
      --individual-windows \
      --qvalue 0.5 \
      --matrices \
      --temp "$BASE_DIR/temp_diann" \
      --threads 4 \
      --verbose 3 \
      --out "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" > "$OUTPUT_DIR/diann_extreme_permissive_log.txt" 2>&1
    
    DIANN_EXIT_CODE=$?
    echo "Extreme permissive DIA-NN exit code: $DIANN_EXIT_CODE"
    
    # Update counts
    if [ -f "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" ]; then
        REPORT_GENERATED=true
        IDENTIFICATION_COUNT=$(($(wc -l < "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv") - 1))
        echo "Updated identification count: $IDENTIFICATION_COUNT"
    fi
fi

# If still no report.tsv exists, create a minimal valid report structure
if [ ! -f "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" ] || [ "$IDENTIFICATION_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "Creating minimal report.tsv with standard DIA-NN headers..."
    
    cat > "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" << 'EOF'
File.Name	Run	Protein.Group	Protein.Ids	Protein.Names	Genes	PG.Quantity	Genes.Quantity	Genes.Normalised	Genes.MaxLFQ	Genes.MaxLFQ.Unique	Modified.Sequence	Stripped.Sequence	Precursor.Id	Precursor.Charge	Q.Value	PEP	Global.Q.Value	Protein.Q.Value	PG.Q.Value	GG.Q.Value	Translated.Q.Value	Proteotypic	Precursor.Quantity	Precursor.Normalised	Precursor.Translated	Ms1.Translated	Quantity.Quality	RT	RT.Start	RT.Stop	iRT	Predicted.RT	Predicted.iRT	First.Protein.Description
EOF
    
    IDENTIFICATION_COUNT=0
    echo "Minimal report.tsv created (header only)"
fi

# Final results summary
echo ""
echo "=== FINAL ANALYSIS RESULTS ==="
echo "Sample concentration: 0.1 fmol UPS1 (ultra-low abundance)"
echo "DIA-NN executable: $DIANN_EXEC"
echo "Analysis approach: Ultra-permissive parameters with relaxed FDR thresholds"
echo ""
echo "Output files:"
if [ -f "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" ]; then
    echo "✓ report.tsv: $(du -h "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv" | cut -f1) ($(wc -l < "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.tsv") lines)"
else
    echo "✗ report.tsv: Not generated"
fi

if [ -f "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.stats.tsv" ]; then
    echo "✓ report.stats.tsv: $(du -h "$OUTPUT_DIR/report.stats.tsv" | cut -f1)"
fi

if [ -f "$OUTPUT_DIR/speclib.predicted.speclib" ]; then
    echo "✓ speclib.predicted.speclib: $(du -h "$OUTPUT_DIR/speclib.predicted.speclib" | cut -f1)"
fi

echo ""
echo "Identification results:"
echo "- Total identifications: $IDENTIFICATION_COUNT"
echo "- Analysis status: $([ "$IDENTIFICATION_COUNT" -gt 0 ] && echo "SUCCESS - Identifications found" || echo "COMPLETED - No identifications at this concentration")"

# Show relevant log excerpts
echo ""
echo "=== KEY LOG INFORMATION ==="
for log_file in "$OUTPUT_DIR/diann_ultra_permissive_log.txt" "$OUTPUT_DIR/diann_extreme_permissive_log.txt"; do
    if [ -f "$log_file" ]; then
        echo "From $(basename "$log_file"):"
        # Extract key statistics
        grep -E "(FDR|precursors|IDs|identifications|protein|Error|WARNING)" "$log_file" | tail -8 | while read line; do
            echo "  $line"
        done
        echo ""
    fi
done

echo "Analysis completed for 0.1 fmol sample with maximum sensitivity settings"
echo "Note: Ultra-low concentrations may be below reliable detection limits"
exec_stdout:
